name: Nightjar Needle
tagline: The command center every serious tattoo artist has been waiting for.
positioning: Nightjar Needle unifies bookings, deposits, consent forms, and client memory into one luminous platform built for independent tattoo artists and studios.

hero.h1: Run your tattoo studio like the institution it deserves to be.
hero.sub: From the first DM to the healed-photo follow-up, Nightjar Needle orchestrates every booking, deposit, and consent form so you can stay at the machine, not the inbox.

features.title: Deposits that never ghost
features.description: Collect non-refundable deposits the moment a client picks a slot. Automatic reminders, reschedule rules, and no-show forfeits protect your day rate.

features.title: Living client memory
features.description: Every stencil, healed photo, allergy note, and touch-up date lives on one profile. Walk into each session knowing exactly where you left off.

features.title: Flash drops on your terms
features.description: Publish flash sheets with claim limits, waitlists, and per-piece pricing. Sell out a Friday drop before you finish your coffee.

features.title: Consent, digitized
features.description: State-aware consent forms, ID capture, and aftercare receipts signed on the client's phone and archived for years, not shoeboxes.

features.title: The calendar that thinks
features.description: Buffer times, setup blocks, and travel days are baked in. Guest-spot residencies and multi-artist chairs stay perfectly deconflicted.

features.title: Revenue in full view
features.description: Track chair utilization, deposit capture, and per-artist take-home with dashboards that make studio decisions obvious.

testimonials.quote: I killed three apps and a paper binder the week I switched. My deposit no-shows went from weekly to basically never, and my consult inbox finally hit zero.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: Guest spots used to be a scheduling nightmare across four cities. Nightjar Needle keeps every chair, waitlist, and deposit straight while I'm on the road.
testimonials.name: Dorian Ash

testimonials.quote: Our healed-photo library and consent archive are audit-proof now. When the health inspector asked, I pulled two years of records in under a minute.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman
